mapper.update: UPDATE permissions SET permission_name = #{permissionName}, permission_code = #{permissionCode}, display_name = #{displayName}, resource = #{resource}, action = #{action}, scope = #{scope}, resource_type = #{resourceType}, module = #{module}, resource_path = #{resourcePath}, http_method = #{httpMethod}, description = #{description}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.permission_name, p.permission_code, p.display_name, p.resource, p.action, COALESCE(rp.scope_override, p.scope) as scope, p.resource_type, p.resource_path, p.http_method, p.description, p.status, p.created_at, p.updated_at FROM permissions p INNER JOIN role_permissions rp ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY p.resource, p.action

SELECT
FROM permissions ORDER BY resource, action LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
